expl.summary: This formula is built without any jet-mass observable: its if-statements use only jet shapes (e2_sq, girth, girth2, width, lam1, LHA, e2, tau1), particle counts and pT sums, and it reaches an accuracy of 0.809 on the validation jets. The mass information comes back through e2_sq (Σ zᵢzⱼΔRᵢⱼ²), girth2 and width, which order jets exactly as (mass/pT)² does: wherever the pack lists their rank correlations, the four values are identical (e.g. -0.627 for neuron 0, 0.705 for neuron 8). Thresholds on these quantities therefore cut jets into bands of mass/pT. W and Z jets are separated by adjacent bands: neuron 0 is largest for e2_sq just below 0.00788 (W jets 1.64, Z jets 0.29) and adds to the W score (+12%) while being subtracted from the Z score (-21%); neuron 7 rewards the next band up (width < 0.0139 but girth2 not below 0.00796; Z jets 1.51, W jets 0.12) and adds to the Z score (+9%) while the W score subtracts it (-6%), with neuron 14 (Z jets 0.89) also subtracted from the W score. Both boson scores subtract neuron 8, which rises with girth2, width and e2_sq (tops 3.49), and add neuron 5 (pT held by the 50 hardest particles). Gluons and quarks are separated by particle multiplicity: neuron 1, which counts pT outside the 50 hardest particles and follows the number of particles (gluons 5.90, quarks 2.27), is the largest input to the g score (+46%) and is subtracted from the q score (-22%); freezing it costs 12.1 accuracy points, far more than any other neuron. The q score adds the narrow-jet neuron 9 (+24%) and subtracts the intermediate-width, low-D2 neuron 4 (-31%). The t score subtracts neuron 13 (-34%, high total pT with little wide-angle pT, on which tops sit lowest) and adds neuron 10 (+30%, large girth, LHA and tau1).

0.title: e2_sq in a band just below 0.00788 (fixed mass/pT), total pT below 1010 GeV
0.measures: Its largest term is e2_sq < 0.00788 (share +0.338); the lower thresholds e2_sq < 0.00618 (-0.131) and e2_sq < 0.0069 (+0.077) take part of that back for the narrowest jets, so the neuron is largest in a band of e2_sq just below 0.00788. Because e2_sq, width, girth2 and (mass/pT)² all have the same rank correlation with it (-0.627), this band is a band of mass/pT, selected without a mass observable. It is pushed down for sum_pt > 1010 GeV (-0.092) and for a dense core (psi_0p2 > 0.909, -0.052), and pushed up for fewer than 18 particles at 0.2 ≤ ΔR < 0.4 (+0.060) and sum_pt_top40 > 860 GeV (+0.057). Mean value: W jets 1.64, quarks 0.83, gluons 0.35, Z jets 0.29, tops 0.10. It is zero for 90% of tops, 52.7% of gluons and 36.9% of Z jets, but only for 2.1% of W jets (AUC 0.93 for W against the rest).
0.role: It raises the W score (+12%) and, slightly, the t score (+2%). It lowers the Z score (-21%), where it is the second-largest input. It does not enter the g or q scores. Since W jets sit high on it and Z jets low, it is one of the neurons that separate W from Z (with neurons 7 and 14); freezing it costs 1.75 accuracy points.

1.title: many particles: pT carried outside the 50 hardest particles
1.measures: Its strongest terms compare the total pT with the pT of the 50 hardest particles: sum_pt > 973 GeV pushes it up (+0.127) while sum_pt_top50 > 940 GeV pushes it down (-0.096); log_sum_pt > 6.91 (+0.092), log_sum_pt < 7.13 (-0.063) and sum_pt_top50 < 1080 GeV (+0.057) act in the same direction, so jets with pT outside their 50 hardest particles gain. It is pushed down when the softest real particle has pT below 2.27 GeV (-0.117; this variable is 0 when the jet has at most 15 particles) and for tau1 > 0.0251 (-0.069), and pushed up for more than 37.9 particles (+0.041). It follows the number of particles (rank correlation 0.651) and the number of particles with pT > 1 GeV (0.632), and falls with the pT share of the 40 hardest particles (-0.613). Mean value: gluons 5.90, tops 2.93, quarks 2.27, Z jets 1.83, W jets 1.61; it is almost never zero (0.2% of gluons, 8.0% of quarks, 10.6% of W jets).
1.role: It raises the g score, where it is the largest input (+46%), and lowers the q score (-22%). It does not enter the W, Z or t scores. Gluons sit far higher on it than quarks (5.90 against 2.27), which makes it the main gluon-quark separator; freezing it costs 12.1 accuracy points, the most of any neuron.

2.title: high total pT, angularity below 0.371, lam1 below 0.0118
2.measures: Pushed down for large angularity (LHA > 0.371, share -0.421, its strongest term), for high pT combined with a broad core of the 30 hardest particles (log_sum_pt > 7.06 AND girth2_top30 > 0.0119, -0.142) and for very narrow jets (girth2 < 0.00695, -0.103); pushed up for lam1 < 0.0118 (+0.231) and log_sum_pt > 6.91 (+0.103). It follows the total pT (rank correlation 0.654 with log_sum_pt, 0.663 with sum_pt_top50). Mean value: gluons 0.59, W jets 0.29, Z jets 0.27, quarks 0.13, tops 0.04; it is zero for 86.7% of tops and 67.2% of quarks.
2.role: It lowers the Z score slightly (-2.4%) and hardly enters the q score (+1.3%). It does not enter the g, W or t scores. Freezing it costs no accuracy (drop -0.06 points).

3.title: few particles overall and at 0.2 ≤ ΔR < 0.4, populated core
3.measures: Pushed up for fewer than 45.5 particles (share +0.274), fewer than 5.25 particles at 0.2 ≤ ΔR < 0.4 (+0.223) and tau21_b2 < 0.21 (+0.072); pushed down when fewer than 24.5 particles lie within ΔR < 0.05 (-0.247) and for a low particle count combined with e2 > 0.0146 (-0.110). It falls with lam2 (rank correlation -0.793), tau4 (-0.761) and the number of particles (-0.738). Mean value: W jets 0.76, quarks 0.66, Z jets 0.56, gluons 0.14, tops 0.03; it is zero for 90.9% of tops and 40.2% of gluons, but for 13.3% of W jets.
3.role: It raises the W score (+4.5%) and the Z score (+4.5%) and lowers the g score (-8%). It does not enter the q or t scores.

4.title: intermediate width (girth2 of the 20 hardest between 0.00779 and 0.0111), low D2
4.measures: Pushed up for width < 0.00988 (share +0.162) and girth2_top20 < 0.0111 (+0.098), pushed down for the narrowest jets (girth2_top40 < 0.00798, -0.124; girth2_top20 < 0.00779, -0.107; e2_sq < 0.00604, -0.067), so it is largest for jets of intermediate width. It is also pushed down for more than 28.6 particles (-0.079), sum_pt_top50 < 1060 GeV (-0.073) and psi_0p1 > 0.391 (-0.055). It falls with D2_b2, D2, tau21_b2 and N2 (rank correlations -0.691, -0.682, -0.672, -0.66) and rises with the mass of the 10 hardest particles (0.655). Mean value: Z jets 1.42, W jets 1.11, tops 0.77, gluons 0.19, quarks 0.12; it is zero for 80.5% of quarks and 67% of gluons, but for about 10% of W, Z and top jets.
4.role: It lowers the q score, where it is the largest input (-31%), and the g score (-16%). It raises the W score (+6%) and the t score (+3.5%). It does not enter the Z score, although Z jets sit highest on it.

5.title: pT held by the 50 hardest particles, e2_sq not above 0.00797, width above 0.00702
5.measures: Its strongest term is sum_pt_top50 > 926 GeV (share +0.300), balanced by log_sum_pt > 6.91 (-0.147), so it gains when the 50 hardest particles carry most of the pT. It is pushed down for e2_sq > 0.00797 (-0.142) and pushed up for width > 0.00702 (+0.122) and more than 23.2 particles with pT > 1 GeV (+0.054). It falls with the number of particles at 0.2 ≤ ΔR < 0.4 (rank correlation -0.616) and the total number of particles (-0.609), and rises with the pT share of the 40 hardest particles (0.561). Mean value: Z jets 1.60, W jets 1.44, quarks 1.36, gluons 0.57, tops 0.33; it is zero for 49.4% of tops and 23.5% of gluons, and almost never for W and Z jets (0.3%, 0.4%).
5.role: It raises the Z score (+17%) and the W score (+15%), and lowers the t score (-13%) and the g score (-8%). It does not enter the q score.

6.title: girth2 above 0.0135 with e2_sq below 0.0271, one-prong substructure
6.measures: Pushed up for e2_sq < 0.0271 (share +0.216), psi_0p3 > 0.986 (+0.088) and lam1 < 0.00389 (+0.080); pushed down for narrow jets (girth2 < 0.0135, -0.171; width < 0.0101, -0.124) and for e2 > 0.0125 (-0.083). The neuron is therefore on for jets that are neither narrow nor very wide. It rises with tau21_b2 and D2_b2 (rank correlations 0.403, 0.401) and falls with e2 (-0.408). Mean value: gluons 0.97, quarks 0.93, tops 0.39, Z jets 0.17, W jets 0.07; it is zero for 91.7% of W jets and 52.1% of Z jets, and for about 20% of gluons and quarks.
6.role: It lowers the Z score (-12%) and raises the q score (+4%). It does not enter the g, W or t scores (shares of 2% or less).

7.title: e2_sq below 0.00973 with girth2 above 0.00796 (the mass/pT band above neuron 0)
7.measures: Pushed up for width < 0.0139 (share +0.155), e2_sq < 0.00973 (+0.116), girth < 0.0565 (+0.061) and LHA < 0.303 (+0.053); pushed down for e2_sq < 0.00963 at sum_pt < 1170 GeV (-0.136), girth2 < 0.00796 (-0.087), girth < 0.0858 (-0.082), girth2_top50 < 0.00637 (-0.065) and LHA < 0.245 (-0.056). It is thus largest for jets somewhat wider than the band of neuron 0 but still below e2_sq 0.00973, especially at high total pT. It rises with eccentricity (rank correlation 0.377) and falls with tau21_b2 (-0.399). Mean value: Z jets 1.51, gluons 0.21, W jets 0.12, tops 0.09, quarks 0.07; it is zero for 12.5% of Z jets, 69.7% of W jets and 91.6% of quarks (AUC 0.91 for Z against the rest).
7.role: It raises the Z score (+9%) and lowers the W score (-6%) and the t score (-3%). It does not enter the g or q scores.

8.title: large girth2, width and e2_sq (wide jets, large mass/pT)
8.measures: Pushed down for girth2 < 0.0263 at log_sum_pt < 7.14 (share -0.249), e2_sq < 0.0102 (-0.096), girth2_top30 < 0.00727 (-0.060) and width < 0.00814 (-0.056); pushed up for girth2 < 0.0271 (+0.179), sum_pt_top50 < 1220 GeV (+0.110), girth2_top30 < 0.00748 at sum_pt < 1280 GeV (+0.084) and tau1 < 0.12 (+0.063). Overall it rises with width, girth2, e2_sq and mass/pT (rank correlation 0.705 for each). Mean value: tops 3.49, gluons 1.41, quarks 0.57, Z jets 0.29, W jets 0.04; it is zero for 94.9% of W jets, 75.9% of quarks and 55.1% of Z jets, and only for 6.2% of tops.
8.role: It lowers the Z score (-26%) and the W score (-24%), in both the largest input, and raises the t score (+6%). It does not enter the g or q scores.

9.title: narrow jets (width below 0.00673), 30 hardest particles below 1200 GeV
9.measures: Pushed up for width < 0.00673 (share +0.299), sum_pt_top30 < 1200 GeV (+0.231), lam1 > 0.00749 (+0.088) and sum_pt_top40 < 956 GeV (+0.042); pushed down for wide jets (girth2 > 0.0258, -0.076; e2_sq > 0.0199, -0.058) and for z_dr_0_0p05 > 0.857 (-0.035). It falls with the mass of the 30 hardest particles (rank correlation -0.645) and with the jet mass (-0.628). Mean value: quarks 2.46, gluons 1.48, tops 0.81, W jets 0.48, Z jets 0.23; it is zero for 79.9% of Z jets and 7.1% of quarks.
9.role: It raises the q score (+24%) and the g score (+14%), and lowers the W score (-6%). It does not enter the Z or t scores.

10.title: large girth, angularity and tau1, pT not held by the 3 hardest particles
10.measures: Pushed up for e2 > 0.00532 (share +0.226), width < 0.00641 (+0.113) and M2 < 0.0854 (+0.057); pushed down for girth < 0.124 (-0.121), sum_pt_top3 > 288 GeV (-0.088), girth < 0.0372 (-0.055) and girth2 > 0.0137 (-0.054). It rises with LHA, tau1 and girth (rank correlations 0.763, 0.761, 0.76) and falls with the pT share within ΔR < 0.05 (-0.747). Mean value: tops 2.33, Z jets 1.15, W jets 0.97, gluons 0.91, quarks 0.58; it is zero for 55.3% of quarks and only for 3% of tops.
10.role: It raises the t score (+30%), its second-largest input. It does not enter the g, q, W or Z scores (shares below 1%). Freezing it costs 2.39 accuracy points, the second-largest drop of any neuron.

11.title: few particles at 0.2 ≤ ΔR < 0.4, girth2 of the 30 hardest between 0.00638 and 0.0118
11.measures: Pushed up for e2_sq < 0.0084 (share +0.217), girth2_top30 < 0.0118 (+0.131), lam1 < 0.00615 at sum_pt < 1120 GeV (+0.083) and few particles at 0.1-0.4 in ΔR (n_dr_0p2_0p4 < 10.4 AND n_dr_0p1_0p2 < 21.9, +0.043); pushed down for the narrowest jets (girth2_top30 < 0.00638, -0.152; lam1 < 0.00606, -0.100) and for e2_sq < 0.0084 at sum_pt < 1120 GeV (-0.121), so the e2_sq term counts mainly at high total pT. It falls with the number of particles at 0.2 ≤ ΔR < 0.4 (rank correlation -0.796) and lam2 (-0.764) and rises with psi_0p2 (0.764). Mean value: W jets 1.55, Z jets 1.20, quarks 0.68, gluons 0.49, tops 0.11; it is zero for 83% of tops and under 2% of W and Z jets.
11.role: It raises the W score (+12%) and lowers the q score (-8%). It does not enter the g, Z or t scores.

12.title: small girth2 (below 0.00637) at high total pT, pT within ΔR < 0.3
12.measures: Its two strongest terms act together at high pT: girth2 < 0.00637 AND log_sum_pt > 6.82 pushes it up (share +0.256), e2_sq < 0.00754 AND log_sum_pt > 6.81 pushes it down (-0.260), and e2_sq < 0.00768 pushes it up (+0.162). It is further pushed up for psi_0p3 > 0.989 (+0.069) and down for psi_0p3 > 0.994 (-0.065) and lam1 < 0.00272 (-0.048). It falls with the jet mass (rank correlation -0.69) and with e2_sq (-0.669). Mean value: quarks 1.62, gluons 0.70, W jets 0.26, Z jets 0.14, tops 0.06; it is zero for 91.8% of Z jets, 91.5% of tops, 60.5% of W jets and 20.5% of quarks.
12.role: It raises the q score (+8%), the Z score (+4%) and the g score (+3%), and lowers the W score (-5%) and the t score (-5%).

13.title: high total pT, pT not spread to wide angles
13.measures: Its strongest term is log_sum_pt > 6.81 (share +0.296); it is pushed down for girth < 0.124 (-0.134), sum_pt > 1010 GeV (-0.110), girth2_top50 > 0.0132 (-0.107) and sum_pt < 1080 GeV (-0.071), and pushed up for girth2_top40 > 0.0125 at sum_pt_top50 < 1190 GeV (+0.059) and sum_pt_top50 < 1070 GeV (+0.051). It rises with log_sum_pt (rank correlation 0.44) and psi_0p2 (0.424) and falls with the pT share at 0.2 ≤ ΔR < 0.4 (-0.424). Mean value: Z jets 1.97, W jets 1.84, gluons 1.62, quarks 1.46, tops 0.57; it is zero for 51.8% of tops and under 1% of W and Z jets.
13.role: It lowers the t score (-34%), where it is the largest input. It does not enter the g, q, W or Z scores.

14.title: e2_sq below 0.0198 with girth2 above 0.00838
14.measures: Pushed up for e2_sq < 0.0198 (share +0.203), girth2_top30 < 0.0123 at sum_pt > 904 GeV (+0.053) and psi_0p3 > 0.989 (+0.041); pushed down for narrow jets (girth2 < 0.00181, -0.204; girth2_top30 < 0.012, -0.151; girth2 < 0.00838, -0.068), so it is on for jets of intermediate width. Its rank correlations with single observables are weak (at most 0.374). Mean value: Z jets 0.89, gluons 0.20, tops 0.08, quarks 0.06, W jets 0.02; it is zero for 92.4% of W jets and 20.2% of Z jets (AUC 0.86 for Z against the rest).
14.role: It lowers the W score (-8%). It does not enter the g, q, Z or t scores.

15.title: small girth (below 0.0795) with angularity above 0.289, little pT at 0.1 ≤ ΔR < 0.2
15.measures: Pushed up for girth < 0.0795 (share +0.307), log_sum_pt < 6.98 (+0.105), girth2_top5 < 0.00762 (+0.079) and z_dr_0p1_0p2 < 0.126 (+0.059); pushed down for LHA < 0.289 (-0.238), girth2_top30 < 0.0137 (-0.097) and sum_pt < 1000 GeV (-0.050). It falls with the pT share and number of particles at 0.1 ≤ ΔR < 0.2 (rank correlations -0.481, -0.429) and rises with psi_0p1 (0.418). Mean value: W jets 0.59, quarks 0.50, Z jets 0.40, gluons 0.20, tops 0.15; it is zero for 56.9% of tops, 51.6% of gluons and 11% of W jets.
15.role: It raises the Z score (+5%) and lowers the t score (-3.5%); its share in the W score is small (-1.7%). It does not enter the g or q scores.

g.title: gluon: many particles, one-prong
g.measures: High for jets with many particles and no two-prong structure: it rises with N2, tau21_b2 and planar flow (rank correlations 0.685, 0.665, 0.638) and falls with eccentricity (-0.638). It averages 3.27 for g jets, 1.11 for quarks and 0.52 for tops, and is negative for W (-1.75) and Z jets (-1.93) (AUC 0.93).
g.built_from: Adds the particle-multiplicity neuron 1 (+46%, its largest input), the narrow-jet neuron 9 (+14%) and a little of neuron 12 (+3%); subtracts the intermediate-width, low-D2 neuron 4 (-16%), neuron 5 (pT held by the 50 hardest particles, -8%) and neuron 3 (few particles, -8%).

q.title: quark: narrow, few particles, high D2
q.measures: High for jets without two-prong structure and with small mass among the hardest particles: it rises with D2_b2 and tau21_b2 (rank correlations 0.68, 0.662) and falls with the mass of the 15 hardest particles (-0.61). It averages 2.79 for q jets and 1.30 for gluons, 0.55 for tops, and is slightly negative for W (-0.12) and negative for Z jets (-0.55) (AUC 0.89).
q.built_from: Adds the narrow-jet neuron 9 (+24%), the small-girth2 neuron 12 (+8%) and neuron 6 (+4%); subtracts the intermediate-width, low-D2 neuron 4 (-31%, its largest input), the particle-multiplicity neuron 1 (-22%), which keeps gluons out, and neuron 11 (-8%).

W.title: W: compact jet in the lower mass/pT band
W.measures: High for compact jets of small mass/pT: it falls with the jet mass (rank correlation -0.65) and with width, girth2, e2_sq and mass/pT (-0.648 each). It averages 3.34 for W jets, 0.39 for quarks and 0.08 for Z jets, and is negative for gluons (-1.11) and tops (-2.72) (AUC 0.97).
W.built_from: Subtracts the wide-jet neuron 8 (-24%, its largest input); adds neuron 5 (+15%), the compact-core neuron 11 (+12%), the e2_sq band below 0.00788 (neuron 0, +12%), neuron 4 (+6%) and neuron 3 (+5%); subtracts the higher-band neurons 14 (-8%) and 7 (-6%), the narrow-jet neuron 9 (-6%) and neuron 12 (-5%).

Z.title: Z: compact jet in the mass/pT band above the W band
Z.measures: High for jets with few particles and little spread along the minor axis: it falls with lam2 (rank correlation -0.603), the number of particles (-0.584) and tau4 (-0.581). It averages 3.05 for Z jets, 0.44 for quarks and 0.35 for W jets, and is negative for gluons (-1.00) and tops (-2.40) (AUC 0.96).
Z.built_from: Subtracts the wide-jet neuron 8 (-26%, its largest input) and the lower e2_sq band (neuron 0, -21%), which removes W jets; adds neuron 5 (+17%) and the higher band (neuron 7, +9%), plus neuron 15 (+5%), neuron 3 (+4.5%) and neuron 12 (+4%); subtracts neuron 6 (-12%) and a little of neuron 2 (-2%).

t.title: top: wide jet, large girth and tau1
t.measures: High for wide jets: it rises with tau1 and girth (rank correlation 0.79 each), LHA (0.78) and mass/pT (0.748). It averages 3.19 for t jets and is near zero for gluons (-0.08) and negative for W (-0.53), Z (-0.89) and quarks (-1.18) (AUC 0.95).
t.built_from: Subtracts neuron 13 (high total pT with little wide-angle pT, -34%, its largest input) and adds neuron 10 (large girth, LHA and tau1, +30%); also subtracts neuron 5 (-13%), neuron 12 (-5%), neuron 15 (-3.5%) and neuron 7 (-3%), and adds neuron 8 (+6%), neuron 4 (+3.5%) and neuron 0 (+2%).
